title: Release of one combination configuration: the exact hash approved, by whom, against which sources

role.description: e.g. content_publisher, platform_owner; a role never exempts anyone from the second-person rule (D254)

configuration_sha256.description: frozen at submit; the approver approves this hash (team pattern: CountryPackDraft.submittedPayloadHash)

author.description: who drafted the pack (team pattern: CountryPackDraft.createdByUserId)

submitter.description: who froze and submitted it for approval (team pattern: CountryPackDraft.submittedByUserId)

approver.description: who approved it (team pattern: CountryPackDraft.approvedByUserId); never the author or the submitter (D254)

publisher.description: who published it, when recorded separately from the approver; never the author or the submitter (D254)
